author: codex
description: Retry transient job failures using capped exponential backoff. Type errors remain terminal. Drain returns the number of jobs executed in this polling interval.

defects.mechanism: The worker reads a queued job instead of claiming it before awaiting the handler. Concurrent pollers execute the same job twice, violating Queue.claim’s ownership contract.
Transient failures neither advance the attempt count nor honor maxAttempts. A permanently failing paid handler is invoked indefinitely instead of exhausting the configured budget.
